nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Recolor the requested subject using one or more target colors.

colors.description: Target colors, from 1 to 25 entries. Each value must use full HEX (#RRGGBB), HSB (hsb(H, S%, B%)), or RGB (rgb(R, G, B)) format. Provide colors or refImageUrls, but not both.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the product image. The image must be between 300 and 4096 pixels in both width and height.

refImageUrls.description: Reference image URLs for reference-image recoloring, from 1 to 25 entries. Provide refImageUrls or colors, but not both.

name: nexscope_one_click_image_recoloring_v2
